invariants.prerequisites: Python >=3.11 and Git; no unattended system installation
invariants.sims_executable: Game/Bin/TS4_x64.exe or TS4.exe in known locations or explicitly selected path
invariants.game_launch: explicit user click; subprocess without shell
invariants.protected_data: never read/write user saves or edit Sims game files
invariants.host_proof: process dispatch is not game load or Live Mode evidence

limitations: Read-only bounded default install discovery may require manual path selection
Existing game-host image-template navigator is independent and requires separately observed calibrated screenshots and strict screen lease
Gameplay and saved-session observations require an authorized Windows P08 run
